description: Diva Daulti Custom Manufacturing Pricing Structure

sampling.description: First piece sampling - pattern making, cutting, and stitching
sampling.process: Pattern making + Cutting + Sourcing + First piece stitching

standard_dress.note: For coord sets, dresses, suits - standard complexity

complex_design.note: Pattern charges increase based on design complexity and silhouettes

sampling.note: Cannot go below ₹3000 for first piece sampling

50_pieces.note: Bulk production - fabric rates are lower in bulk

production.note: More pieces = better rates. Bulk fabric rates reduce overall cost

embroidery.estimation_process: We provide a general time estimate, but final charges are based on actual time taken by the karigaar (craftsman) after completing the work
embroidery.note: Time estimates are approximate. Actual billing is done after the karigaar completes the work and confirms the exact hours

block_making.description: Craftsman carves wooden block for unique designs
block_making.note: One-time cost if it's a unique design

printing_cost.production: To be confirmed based on quantity
printing_cost.note: For sampling or small batches under 5 meters

different_sizes.note: One-time pattern cost per different size

delivery.note: Delivery charges to be borne by the client

fabric_policy.client_provides: No fabric cost, only manufacturing charges
fabric_policy.we_provide: Manufacturing charges + Fabric cost + Logistics cost

product_types.western_wear: All types of western wear available
product_types.traditional_wear: Indian ethnic wear, sarees, suits, lehengas, etc.
product_types.custom_designs: Any custom design can be manufactured

dress_with_embroidery.note: Embroidery time estimated initially, final charge after karigaar completes work
